deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for the chemical engineering PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Only a limited number of scholarships and stipends are offered, mostly tied to assistantships or an MS thesis.
funding.quote: A limited number of one-year and partial-year tuition scholarships are available for qualified full-time students.

also.quote: A limited number of stipends are also available.

entry_route.value: A BS or BE in chemical engineering is the prerequisite; other science or engineering graduates can be admitted after making up gaps.
entry_route.quote: Prerequisites: BS or BE in Chemical Engineering.

also.quote: Those with degrees in other science or engineering disciplines may also be admitted but are required to make up undergraduate course deficiencies.

notes: Housed in the Coulter School of Engineering and Applied Sciences and the Center for Advanced Materials Processing; the same online application applies.
